If it fails, you form DELTA GREEN Bonds with up to {Max} teammates who were there, or strengthen the ones you have, and your other Bonds pay for it: 1 point for any new Bonds, and 1 for each one strengthened.
investigator.IfItFailsLoseCountPoints: If it fails, your other Bonds lose: {Count}
investigator.OnlyThisMuchOfCountCanBePai: ({Count} are owed, but your other Bonds can’t pay any more.)
investigator.ChooseTheTeammatesPresent: Choose the teammates who were there

investigator.ACrisisNeedsAtLeastTwo: A team crisis needs at least two people there
investigator.EstablishBondTooltip: Roll to establish a new Bond between operations
investigator.EstablishBondHint: You attempt to forge a new bond with someone. You lose 1 {Category} point, which you don't get back before the next operation, and another bond is weakened by 1 point, then roll a die. 1: They reject you and you lose 1 {AbilityName}; 2–5: the Bond starts at the die minus 2; 6: it starts at 3, and you get the {Category} point back.
investigator.NeglectBreaksBondConfirm: Neglecting {BondName} will break that Bond for good. Go ahead anyway?
investigator.CantEstablishBondLikeThat: Can’t establish that Bond with those choices any more
investigator.AdaptationHint: Tick a box each time {AbilityName} is lost to this kind of trauma without becoming Shaken, and clear them on becoming Shaken. With all {Count} ticked, the character is adapted for good: {AbilityName} tests against that kind of trauma get easier.
investigator.BondCapNote: Adapted to {Trauma}: no Bond can go above {BondCap}.
investigator.StabilityStatusUpdateFailed: Couldn’t update the Stability status of {ActorName}.
investigator.SpendWhileShakenConfirm: {ActorName} is in no state to spend Investigative points. Spend from {AbilityName} anyway?
investigator.CantMakeTraumaTestLikeThat: Can’t make that test with those choices any more
investigator.ShakenReminder: General tests are at +1 Difficulty, and no Investigative spends without the GM’s say-so.
investigator.ShatteredReminder: As Shaken, plus a lasting mental illness, at the GM’s discretion.
investigator.GoneReminder: One last act, then the {GenericOccupation} is lost: time for a new character.
investigator.SanityCapNote: {Sanity}’s rating can’t go above the base cap less the rating of the ability which caps it.
investigator.StabilityStatesNote: Each state starts when the {Stability} pool drops to the number given. Leave a name empty to use the usual one. What the states do stays the same.
investigator.TraumaTypesDescription: What Stability is tested against, and adapting to it

investigator.AdaptationCapsBondsConfirm: No Bond can be raised above {BondCap}; Bonds already above it stay until they’re lost.
investigator.AdaptationCapsAbilitiesEffe: {AbilityNames} are capped at {RatingCap}. Points already above the cap can still be spent, but won’t come back.
investigator.AdaptationCapsBondsEffect: Bonds are capped at {BondCap}, and those above it stay until they’re lost.
investigator.AdaptationRefreshPenaltyEff: Refreshes during an operation give up to {Penalty} fewer points (Full Refresh not included).
investigator.TrailOfCthulhuRulesOffer: Trail of Cthulhu now has optional Stability and Sanity rules. Enable them now? (You can change this later in {Settings}.)
